analyst_view.overall: Early view: Sunderland beat Chelsea 1-0 at the Stadium of Light before the break, but they are 19th, also playing in the Europa League, and Granit Xhaka's calf is a concern. Spurs lost 1-0 at Leeds and have a long injury list in attack. Both play on 21 November first, so this view will move with those results.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.3 goals. I lean slightly lower: Sunderland's home win over Chelsea was a 1-0, and Spurs failed to score at Leeds with Simons, Odobert and Mudryk among the injured.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.5 corners, 5.2 for Spurs. That fits Spurs having more of the ball away from home, and nothing in the news moves it.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.5 cards. I lean higher: Sunderland had six bookings against Chelsea, including Le Bris, and Spurs had three players and De Zerbi booked at Leeds. Both sides have been running up cards.

shots.text: The numbers say 25.8 shots. Sunderland's Europa League commitments may tire legs and hand Spurs more of the ball, but Spurs' injuries limit their attack, so I keep the site's figure.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 7.8 shots on target. I lean slightly lower: neither attack is firing, with Spurs blank at Leeds and Sunderland's goal against Chelsea coming from a penalty.
